_README: Hand-curated booth facts that no crawled source publishes - coordinates above all.
Staged through the normal extracted_record -> resolve path under the 'manual'
source (priority_rank 0), so these values win field resolution against every
crawled source and are never overwritten by a later refresh. Applied by
`epcot-fw manual apply`, and automatically at the start of crawl/refresh.
`name` is matched fuzzily against booths for the current festival, exactly the
way a crawled record is, so it does not have to be byte-identical to the
canonical name. A name that matches nothing confidently is reported rather than
Every field except `name` is optional - omit what you have not surveyed rather
than writing a placeholder, because a null is never merged but a wrong number
is. Coordinates are decimal degrees (WGS84); ~5 decimal places is about a
metre, which is far more than enough to sort booths by distance.
Booth positions are stable season to season, so this file is worth surveying
